title: William's Silly Little Splashes
description: A random mod i came up with, adds some random text as splashes
body: 🔴(YOU HAVE TO RESTART AFTER ACTIVATING)🔴 My first Resource Pack, i don't really plan on making real mods because i can't code, do textures. I just thought this will be good, anyways, a splash text is the little yellow text that's at the main menu. You can modify, reupload this pack, but HAVE to give me credit. Just say "Original by William38622" and if you want to, but you don't have to. is put a link to the original. You cannot blame me for any edits you may make.
